title: Trabajadores y movimientos sociales
goal: Read about the urban labor movement as a second revolutionary current alongside rural land conflict, and why the two rarely managed to form a lasting alliance.
grammar: Sin que + subjuntivo: lo que no llegó a ocurrir

items: Name the second revolutionary current alongside agrarian tension.

Explain what some socialist and anarchist leaders understood both movements shared.
